backcard_card_text:
[Permanent] You can't send cards from Drop Areas to Warps.
[Auto][Sparking 7] (This skill takes effect when you have 7 or more cards in your Drop Area.) When this card attacks, draw 1 card, and this card gets +5000 power for the duration of the turn.
[Activate : Main][Once per turn] Choose 1 of your energy : You may place the chosen energy in your Drop Area. If you do, choose up to 1 〈Majin Buu〉 card in your Drop Area, and add it to your energy in Rest Mode.
card_text:
[Permanent] You can't send cards from Drop Areas to Warps.
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card.
[Activate: Main][Once per turn][Burst 3] (You must place the top 3 cards of your deck in your Drop Area to activate this skill.) Choose 1 of your energy : You may place the chosen energy in your Drop Area. If you do, choose up to 1 〈Majin Buu〉 card in your Drop Area and add it to your energy in Rest Mode.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less : You may draw 1 card, then choose up to 1 of your energy, switch it to Active Mode, and flip this card over.
